verdict.rationale: Supabase is a backend-as-a-service platform, not an agent/host that itself plugs in external MCP servers to gain new tools; the evidence instead shows the reverse relationship—Supabase exposes its own official MCP server so that AI assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) can call Supabase's tools. This story asks about MCP-client/host behavior, which is a category mismatch for a database/backend platform.
